Tipos de abono transportes disponibles y tarifas 2026 para la **Tarjeta Transporte Público** y resto de billetes y cupones de transporte público de Madrid.

### Abono transportes 30 días

Lista de precios de abonos mensuales disponibles para la **Tarjeta Transporte Público** de Madrid:

#### Abono Normal 1 Zona

*   Zona A: 32,70 €

El abono joven (entre 15 y 25 años) tiene un precio de 10 € y es gratuito para menores de 14 años y a partir de los 65 años.

The answer comes from the third URL, https://www.redtransporte.com/madrid/precios-abonos.html. It's an unofficial aggregator, not Metro de Madrid or CRTM, and its explanation of the per-station pricing contains obvious errors (details below).

**What happened with each URL**
1. https://www.metromadrid.es/es/viaja-en-metro/titulos-y-tarifas/tarifas returned HTTP 200, but the page was Metro de Madrid's security block page: "No ha sido posible acceder a esta página", with the request flagged as not allowed (Support ID 14059281727368854164). It had no fare information.
2. https://www.crtm.es/billetes-y-tarifas.aspx returned HTTP 404 Not Found.
3. https://www.redtransporte.com/madrid/precios-abonos.html returned HTTP 200 and has the fares.

**Metro Zona A single ticket (redtransporte)**
- "Billete sencillo Metro Zona A: 1,50 - 2,00 €"
- Per-station explanation, quoted in parts: "El billete sencillo de 1,50 € es válido para recorridos de hasta 5 estaciones"; for 6–9 stations "el precio se incrementa 0 € por cada estación"; and "A partir de 10 estaciones el precio es de 10 €".
  - **Don't trust this part.** The "0 € per station" increase and the "10 €" price from 10 stations on contradict the page's own 1,50–2,00 € range. They look like template or data errors. The only parts you can rely on are 1,50 € for up to 5 stations and a 2,00 € maximum. The page doesn't give the correct per-station increase.
- Related prices on the same page: "Billete 10 viajes Metro Zona A: 7,30 €", "Suplemento Aeropuerto: 3,00 €" (added to single tickets to or from the airport), "Billete sencillo Combinado: 3,00 €", MetroNorte/Este/Sur single 1,50 €, MetroOeste/TFM single 2,00 €.

**Date and validity info**
- The page is titled "Precios de billetes y abonos transporte en Madrid (tarifas 2026)" and says its prices were "actualizados en 2026".
- No effective date, last-updated date or validity period is given for the single ticket. The footer reads "© RedTransporte 2009-2026".
